ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited's Board of Directors held a routine meeting on September 5, 2026, to approve the draft Annual Report for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026, and to schedule its 36th Annual General Meeting (AGM) for September 30, 2026, to be held virtually. This is a procedural corporate governance announcement, presenting no immediate material financial impacts or significant red flags, although a minor typographical error was noted in the document regarding the scrutinizer's title.
